purpose: Canonical evidence file for 2022. Only sourced records in this file are eligible for later card scoring.

records.title: Wormhole bridge exploit mints 120,000 unbacked wrapped ETH
records.summary: An attacker exploited Wormhole's Solana-Ethereum bridge verification logic and minted about 120,000 wrapped ETH without corresponding collateral, worth over $320 million at the time.
records.significance: The attack became one of the largest DeFi thefts and exposed the systemic risks created when cross-chain bridges hold or synthesize large pools of assets.

sources.title: Chainalysis — Lessons from the Wormhole exploit
CertiK — Wormhole Bridge Exploit Incident Analysis

records.title: Ronin bridge is drained of 173,600 ETH and 25.5 million USDC
records.summary: Attackers compromised validator keys and drained 173,600 ETH and 25.5 million USDC from the Ronin bridge supporting Axie Infinity.
records.significance: The Ronin theft was the defining gaming/bridge hack of the cycle and demonstrated how concentrated validator control could undermine a large blockchain economy.

sources.title: Ronin — The Ronin Bridge Is Open
US Treasury — Tornado Cash sanctions background on Ronin laundering

records.title: TerraUSD loses its dollar peg
records.summary: Beginning around 7 May, large UST sales destabilized the peg; the algorithm failed to restore parity and UST ultimately fell close to zero.
records.significance: The failure destroyed confidence in algorithmic stablecoins and triggered losses throughout the interconnected crypto credit system.

sources.title: SEC complaint — Terraform Labs / May 2022 collapse

records.title: LUNA enters a hyperinflationary death spiral
records.summary: As UST failed, Terra's stabilization mechanism rapidly expanded LUNA supply while both UST and LUNA prices collapsed toward zero.
records.significance: The death spiral erased tens of billions of dollars in market value and became the canonical failure mode for reflexive algorithmic stablecoin designs.

sources.title: SEC complaint — Terraform Labs / May 2022 collapse

records.title: Celsius halts customer withdrawals
records.summary: Celsius announced a halt to customer withdrawals on 12 June 2022. US prosecutors later said hundreds of thousands of users still had roughly $4.7 billion of crypto assets trapped on the platform.
records.significance: The freeze turned fears about opaque crypto lending into a full-scale retail bank-run crisis and accelerated the 2022 CeFi contagion.

records.title: Three Arrows Capital defaults on major Voyager loan
records.summary: Voyager issued a notice of default to Three Arrows Capital after 3AC failed to repay 15,250 BTC and $350 million USDC.
records.significance: The default made 3AC's insolvency visible to the market and showed how leverage and unsecured institutional lending were transmitting Terra-era losses across crypto firms.

sources.title: Voyager — Three Arrows Capital default notice

records.title: Voyager Digital files for Chapter 11 bankruptcy
records.summary: Voyager filed for Chapter 11 protection after the prolonged market downturn and Three Arrows Capital's default on more than $650 million of loans.
records.significance: Voyager's bankruptcy illustrated how 3AC losses cascaded into retail-facing crypto lenders and became a central episode in the 2022 contagion chain.

records.title: US Treasury sanctions Tornado Cash
records.summary: OFAC sanctioned Tornado Cash on 8 August 2022, citing its use in laundering billions of dollars of virtual currency including proceeds from major hacks.
records.significance: The sanctions created one of crypto's most important legal and philosophical disputes over privacy software, immutable smart contracts and government sanctions powers.

records.title: Ethereum completes The Merge
records.summary: Ethereum's Paris upgrade switched mainnet consensus from proof of work to proof of stake at block 15,537,394.
records.significance: The Merge was one of the largest live consensus migrations ever attempted and reduced Ethereum's energy consumption by roughly 99.95%.

records.title: FTX and affiliated companies file for bankruptcy
records.summary: FTX Trading and numerous affiliated entities filed for Chapter 11 protection on 11 November 2022 after a liquidity crisis and revelations about the relationship between FTX and Alameda Research.
records.significance: FTX's collapse was the defining centralized-exchange failure of the cycle and produced one of the largest crises of confidence in crypto history.

sources.title: SEC complaint — Samuel Bankman-Fried / FTX bankruptcy background

records.title: Sam Bankman-Fried is arrested in the Bahamas
records.summary: Sam Bankman-Fried was arrested in the Bahamas on 12 December 2022 ahead of the unsealing of a US federal indictment.
records.significance: The arrest converted FTX's market collapse into one of the most consequential criminal cases in financial and crypto history.
